Name: Marnie and Lewis - No More Secrets - Wedding
Author: RussetGwen
Description:
Marnie and Lewis: No More Secrets gives their long-running secret relationship a complete story arc.

FEATURES

• Six connected heart events
• Lewis struggles with his fear of gossip and his public reputation
• Marnie refuses to remain a secret
• A public confession and marriage proposal
• A full wedding event with Pelican Town residents
• New dialogue before and after the wedding
• Shared schedules and visible daytime walks after marriage
• Built-in translations: English, Russian, Portuguese, French, Italian, German, and Ukrainian

INSTALLATION

1. Install SMAPI.
2. Install Content Patcher.
3. Extract both folders from this archive into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

REQUIREMENTS

• Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer
• SMAPI 4.1.10 or newer
• Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer

The mod uses its own small framework component to reliably count the seven days between Lewis's proposal and the wedding. Keep both included folders installed.

COMPATIBILITY

This mod edits events, dialogue, and schedules for Marnie and Lewis. Mods that replace the same events or schedules may conflict.

TRANSLATIONS

All player-facing text is stored in the i18n folder. Translators can copy default.json, rename it to their language code, and translate only the values while keeping the keys and Stardew dialogue markers unchanged.
